can_do.en: I can talk about my work experience and ask about a job.
can_do.zh: 我能介绍自己的工作经验，并就应聘职位提问。

scene.en: A short video job interview with Dorota, an HR manager at a software company in Kraków.
scene.zh: 在波兰克拉科夫一家软件公司的简短在线视频面试，面试官是人力资源主管多罗塔（Dorota）。

mission.en: Introduce yourself and your experience
mission.zh: 简要自我介绍并概述工作背景

mission.en: Explain why you want the job
mission.zh: 阐述申请该职位的原因

mission.en: Ask one question about the role
mission.zh: 针对该职位提出一个问题

complication.en: She asks you about your weaknesses.
complication.zh: 她询问你工作中有什么缺点或不足。

opener.en: Good morning, nice to meet you. Shall we get started?
opener.zh: 早上好，很高兴认识你。我们这就开始吧？

first_question.en: Could you tell me a little about yourself?
first_question.zh: 能先简单介绍一下你自己吗？

closer.en: Thank you for your time. We'll be in touch next week.
closer.zh: 感谢你的时间，我们下周会与你联系。

phrases.en: I've been working as a programmer for five years.
phrases.zh: “我从事程序员工作已经五年了。”（用于说明从事某职业的从业年限）

phrases.en: I speak English and some Polish.
phrases.zh: “我会说英语，还会一点波兰语。”（用于介绍自己的语言能力）

phrases.en: I'm interested in this position because...
phrases.zh: “我对这个职位很感兴趣，因为……”（用于阐明自己的求职动机）

phrases.en: One of my greatest strengths is problem-solving.
phrases.zh: “我最大的优势之一是善于解决问题。”（用于展示个人核心长处）

phrases.en: Is remote work an option?
phrases.zh: “这个岗位可以远程办公吗？”（用于礼貌询问工作模式）

grammar_focus.en: Present perfect continuous: "I've been working as... for [time]"
grammar_focus.zh: 现在完成进行时（have been working），用于表达从过去开始一直持续到现在的工作经历。

title.en: Signing Up for a Language Course

can_do.en: I can enrol in a language course and ask practical questions.
can_do.zh: 我能报名语言课程并咨询具体的实用细节。

scene.en: The front desk of a language school in Kraków, talking to the receptionist, Paweł.
scene.zh: 在克拉科夫一家语言学校的前台，向前台接待员帕维乌（Paweł）咨询报名。

mission.en: State your current level and learning goals
mission.zh: 说明自己目前的语言级别与学习目标

mission.en: Choose your preferred days and times
mission.zh: 选择适合的上课日期和时段

mission.en: Ask about the price and course materials
mission.zh: 询问学费及是否包含教材

complication.en: The group you want is full, so you need to pick another time.
complication.zh: 你想报的班已经招满了，需要选择另一个上课时间。

first_question.en: Which course are you interested in?

closer.en: Great, see you at the first class!
closer.zh: 太好了，那我们第一节课上见！

phrases.en: I'm currently at level A2.
phrases.zh: “我目前是A2水平。”（用于说明语言基础）

phrases.en: I want to improve my speaking.
phrases.zh: “我想提高口语表达能力。”（用于表达学习期望）

phrases.en: I'd prefer evening classes twice a week.
phrases.zh: “我更想选一周两次的晚班。”（用于选择上课频次与时间段）

phrases.en: How much is the course per semester?
phrases.zh: “每学期的学费是多少？”（用于询问课程费用）

phrases.en: Is the textbook included in the price?
phrases.zh: “费用里包含教材吗？”（用于确认收费包含的项目）

grammar_focus.en: Questions about price and inclusion: "How much is...?" and "Is ... included?"
grammar_focus.zh: 咨询价格与包含项目的常用疑问句：“How much is...?”（多少钱）与被动疑问句“Is ... included?”（是否包含）。

can_do.en: I can ask for help politely and agree on a meeting time.
can_do.zh: 我能礼貌地向同事求助并约定碰头时间。

scene.en: At work in Kraków; you need help from your team lead, Ania, with a report.
scene.zh: 在波兰克拉科夫的公司工位，你需要组长阿尼娅（Ania）协助看一份报告。

mission.en: Ask politely for assistance
mission.zh: 客气地请求对方协助

mission.en: Explain what the problem is
mission.zh: 说明自己遇到的具体问题

mission.en: Agree on a convenient time to go over it
mission.zh: 商定一个碰面探讨的时间

complication.en: She is busy until three o'clock.
complication.zh: 她下午三点之前一直在忙。

first_question.en: Do you need a hand with something?
first_question.zh: 有什么需要我帮忙的吗？

closer.en: OK, come by my desk at three. See you then!
closer.zh: 行，三点来我工位吧。待会儿见！

phrases.en: Could you give me a hand with this?
phrases.zh: “你能抽空帮我看一下这个吗？”（用于礼貌请求他人协助）

phrases.en: I'm having a problem with the report.
phrases.zh: “我这份报告遇到了一点问题。”（用于说明需要求助的事项）

phrases.en: I don't really understand this table.
phrases.zh: “我不太看得懂这张表格的数据。”（用于具体说明卡点）

phrases.en: When do you need it by?
phrases.zh: “这个最晚什么时候要交？”（用于确认任务的截止时间）

phrases.en: Thanks so much, you've been a great help!
phrases.zh: “太感谢了，真是帮了大忙！”（用于真诚致谢）

grammar_focus.en: Polite requests with "Could you...?" and "Can you...?"
grammar_focus.zh: 情态动词 could / can 引导的礼貌请求句型，表达比直接祈使句更得体客气。

can_do.en: I can reschedule a meeting and give a clear reason.
can_do.zh: 我能说明原因并重新协调会议时间。

scene.en: You need to move tomorrow's meeting with your team lead, Ania.
scene.zh: 你需要找组长阿尼娅（Ania）调整明天原本定好的会议。

mission.en: Explain why you cannot make the meeting tomorrow
mission.zh: 说明明天无法参会的原因

mission.en: Suggest another day and time
mission.zh: 提议另一个合适的日期与时段

mission.en: Confirm the new appointment
mission.zh: 确认改期后的最终时间

complication.en: The rest of the team is only free on Friday morning.
complication.zh: 组里其他人只有周五上午有空。

opener.en: Hey, I have a quick minute. What did you want to talk about?
opener.zh: 嗨，我有两分钟空。你想聊什么事？

closer.en: All right, I'll send out a new invite. Talk later!
closer.zh: 行，我重新发一份会议邀请。回头聊！

phrases.en: I can't make it tomorrow because something came up.
phrases.zh: “我明天去不了，临时有点急事。”（用于说明无法赴约）

phrases.en: Could we move the meeting to another day?
phrases.zh: “我们能把会改到改天吗？”（用于提议改期）

phrases.en: Does Thursday work for you?
phrases.zh: “周四你方便吗？”（用于征询对方时间安排）

phrases.en: Friday morning works for me.
phrases.zh: “周五上午我可以。”（用于确认自己的空闲时间）

phrases.en: Sounds good, it's confirmed!
phrases.zh: “好的，那就这么定！”（用于最后拍板时间）

grammar_focus.en: "I can't make it" and "Does [day/time] work for you?" for scheduling
grammar_focus.zh: 预约常用短语“can't make it”（赶不上/无法出席）与“Does ... work for you?”（你方便吗？）。

can_do.en: I can check in at a guesthouse and resolve an issue with my room.
can_do.zh: 我能办理入住手续并沟通更换有问题的房间。

scene.en: The front desk of a guesthouse in Zakopane, a mountain resort town in southern Poland, talking to the receptionist, Adam.
scene.zh: 在波兰南部著名的山区度假小镇扎科帕内（Zakopane）的一家民宿前台，与接待员亚当（Adam）交谈。

mission.en: Check in using your reservation name
mission.zh: 报预订人姓名办理入住

mission.en: Ask about breakfast times and the Wi-Fi password
mission.zh: 询问早餐时间与无线网密码

mission.en: Report a problem with your room
mission.zh: 反映房间存在的问题并请求处理

complication.en: Your room faces a noisy street; ask to switch to a quieter one.
complication.zh: 你的房间临街非常吵闹，需要换一间安静点的房间。

opener.zh: 晚上好，欢迎来到扎科帕内！

first_question.en: What name is the booking under?
first_question.zh: 预订登记的是哪位客人的名字？

closer.en: Here's your key. Enjoy your stay!
closer.zh: 这是您的房门钥匙。祝您住得愉快！

phrases.en: I have a reservation under the name...
phrases.zh: “我有一份预订，登记的名字是……”（用于在前台报姓名办入住）

phrases.en: What time is breakfast served?
phrases.zh: “早餐几点开始供应？”（用于询问早餐时段）

phrases.en: Could you tell me the Wi-Fi password?
phrases.zh: “请问无线网密码是多少？”（用于客气询问网络密码）

phrases.en: The room is very noisy because it faces the street.
phrases.zh: “房间靠街，特别吵。”（用于指出房间缺陷）

phrases.en: Is it possible to change rooms?
phrases.zh: “可以帮我换一间房吗？”（用于提出换房请求）

grammar_focus.en: Indirect questions: "Could you tell me...?" and "What time is...?"
grammar_focus.zh: 间接疑问句“Could you tell me...?”与常见服务咨询疑问句“What time is...?”。

can_do.en: I can plan a trip with a friend and divide up tasks.
can_do.zh: 我能和朋友一起制定旅行计划并分工准备。

scene.en: Planning a weekend hike in the Tatra Mountains with your friend Tomek.
scene.zh: 和朋友托梅克（Tomek）一起商量周末去波兰南部的塔特拉山脉（Tatra Mountains）徒步度假。

mission.en: Agree on how to travel there
mission.zh: 商定前往山区的交通方式

mission.en: Choose where to spend the night
mission.zh: 选定住宿地点

mission.en: Split the tasks and decide who gets what
mission.zh: 分工明确各自负责准备什么

complication.en: The bus is sold out, so you need to find another way.
complication.zh: 大巴车票卖光了，需要另想出行办法。

opener.en: Hey, we're finally going to the Tatras!
opener.zh: 嗨，我们终于要去塔特拉山啦！

first_question.en: How should we go: by train or by bus?
first_question.zh: 我们怎么去比较好，坐火车还是坐大巴？

closer.en: Awesome, it's going to be great! See you Saturday!
closer.zh: 太棒了，这趟肯定超级好玩！周六见！

phrases.en: Let's take the train instead.
phrases.zh: “要不我们改坐火车吧。”（用于提议出行交通工具）

phrases.en: We can stay at a mountain hostel.
phrases.zh: “我们可以住山上的木屋旅舍（波兰山区特色庇护所）。”（用于提出住宿建议）

phrases.en: I'll book the tickets.
phrases.zh: “买票的事交给我吧。”（用于主动承担某项准备任务）

phrases.en: Can you bring the trail map?
phrases.zh: “你能带张登山地图吗？”（用于请同伴负责带某样物品）

phrases.en: What if there are no seats left?
phrases.zh: “要是连座都没了怎么办？”（用于提出应急疑问）

grammar_focus.en: Making suggestions and offers: "Let's...", "We can...", and "I'll..."
grammar_focus.zh: 提出建议（Let's... / We can...）与即时承诺承担任务（I'll + 动词原形）。

can_do.en: I can talk about the weather forecast and future travel plans.
can_do.zh: 我能谈论天气预报并讨论出行计划。

scene.en: You run into your elderly neighbour Marek on the stairs while carrying a large backpack.
scene.zh: 背着大登山包下楼时，在楼道里偶遇热心的老邻居马雷克（Marek）。

mission.en: Tell him where you are going and when
mission.zh: 告诉他你要去哪里以及行程时间

mission.en: Ask about the weather forecast
mission.zh: 打听接下来的天气预报情况

mission.en: Mention what gear or clothes you will take
mission.zh: 说明自己打算携带的装备或衣物

complication.en: He warns that a storm is coming; ask if you should still go.
complication.zh: 他提醒说马上会有暴风雨，你需要问他现在还适不适合进山。

opener.en: Hello! Where are you off to with that big backpack?
opener.zh: 你好呀！背这么大一个包，这是打算去哪儿啊？

first_question.en: Have you checked the weather forecast?
first_question.zh: 你查过那边的天气预报了吗？

closer.en: Take care out there. Have a safe trip!
closer.zh: 路上多当心，祝你旅途平安！

phrases.en: I'm going to the mountains for the weekend.
phrases.zh: “我这周末打算去山区玩。”（用于说明周末出行计划）

phrases.en: What's the weather going to be like?
phrases.zh: “天气预报说会是什么天气？”（用于询问未来天气状况）

phrases.en: Is it going to rain?
phrases.zh: “天会下雨吗？”（用于确认下雨概率）

phrases.en: I'll pack a raincoat just in case.
phrases.zh: “我会带上一件雨衣备用。”（用于说明随身防雨装备）

phrases.en: I hope it stays sunny.
phrases.zh: “真希望到时候一直是晴天。”（用于表达期望）

grammar_focus.en: Talking about the future: "be going to" for predictions and plans, "will" for decisions
grammar_focus.zh: 一般将来时结构：用 be going to 谈论依据迹象的天气预测与既定计划，用 will / I'll 表达临场决定。

can_do.en: I can complain politely about a meal and ask for an alternative or the bill.
can_do.zh: 我能客气地反馈菜品问题，并要求更换或结账。

scene.en: A traditional restaurant in Kraków's Old Town; there is an issue with your meal, and Kuba is your waiter.
scene.zh: 在克拉科夫老城区的一家餐馆，你点的菜品出了点状况，服务员库巴（Kuba）前来询问。

mission.en: Explain politely what is wrong with your food
mission.zh: 客气说明食物有什么问题

mission.en: Ask for something else instead
mission.zh: 询问能否换一道其他的餐点

mission.en: Ask for the bill
mission.zh: 要求买单结账

complication.en: The kitchen is closing, so they can only offer you a dessert.
complication.zh: 后厨马上打烊了，只能为您免费提供一份甜点作补偿。

opener.en: How was everything with your meal?
opener.zh: 请问菜品用得还满意吗？

first_question.en: Is there something wrong with your dish?
first_question.zh: 是菜品有什么不对的地方吗？

closer.en: We're so sorry about that. Dessert is on the house!
closer.zh: 实在非常抱歉。今天的甜点由我们餐厅免费赠送！

phrases.en: Excuse me, but the soup is cold.
phrases.zh: “不好意思，这碗汤凉了。”（用于客气指出饭菜温度不达标）

phrases.en: I'm sorry, but this isn't what I ordered.
phrases.zh: “抱歉，这道好像不是我点的菜。”（用于指出上错菜）

phrases.en: Could I have something else instead?
phrases.zh: “能帮我换一道别的菜吗？”（用于提出更换要求）

phrases.en: Could we have the bill, please?
phrases.zh: “你好，麻烦买单。”（用于用餐结束结账）

phrases.en: No problem, that's fine.
phrases.zh: “没关系，不用介意。”（用于大度接受店方解释）

grammar_focus.en: Polite complaints and requests: "Excuse me, but..." and "Could I have...?"
grammar_focus.zh: 礼貌异议缓冲语“Excuse me, but...”与客气求助句型“Could I have...?”。

can_do.en: I can express and defend my opinions about movies.
can_do.zh: 我能表达自己对电影的喜好与看法，并进行探讨。

scene.en: Choosing a movie to watch together at home with your friend Kasia.
scene.zh: 在家里客厅，和好友卡夏（Kasia）商量挑选今晚一起看的电影。

mission.en: Say what types of movies you like and why
mission.zh: 说明自己喜欢看什么类型的电影及原因

mission.en: Politely disagree with her choice
mission.zh: 委婉地对她的片单提议表示不同意

mission.en: Agree on one film to watch
mission.zh: 达成共识敲定一部大家都想看的片子

complication.en: She only wants to watch horror movies, which you really dislike.
complication.zh: 她一心只想看恐怖片，而你平时最受不了恐怖片。

opener.en: So, what are we watching tonight?

first_question.en: What kind of movies do you like?
first_question.zh: 你平时喜欢看哪类片子？

closer.en: Great, I'm pressing play! Is the popcorn ready?
closer.zh: 好嘞，我现在点播放！爆米花准备好了吗？

phrases.en: I enjoy comedies because they help me relax.
phrases.zh: “我挺喜欢看喜剧片的，很让人放松。”（用于表达喜好与理由）

phrases.en: I can't stand horror movies.
phrases.zh: “我真受不了恐怖片。”（用于强烈表达不喜欢的类型）

phrases.en: In my opinion, this one looks a bit boring.
phrases.zh: “依我看，这部看着有点沉闷。”（用于委婉发表个人评价）

phrases.en: You're right, but maybe something lighter?
phrases.zh: “你说得有道理，但要不要看个轻松点的？”（用于先肯定对方再转折建议）

phrases.en: Sounds good, let's watch that one!
phrases.zh: “好呀，那就看这部吧！”（用于同意对方提议）

grammar_focus.en: Giving opinions and gentle disagreement: "In my opinion..." and "You're right, but..."
grammar_focus.zh: 发表个人观点句型“In my opinion...”与委婉反驳句式“You're right, but...”（你说得对，但是……）。

can_do.en: I can accept an invitation and discuss holiday traditions.
can_do.zh: 我能欣然接受节日邀请并交流不同文化里的传统习俗。

scene.en: December in Kraków; your elderly neighbour Marek invites you to Wigilia (traditional Polish Christmas Eve) with his family.
scene.zh: 12月的克拉科夫，热心的老邻居马雷克（Marek）邀请你去他家参加维吉利亚（Wigilia，波兰传统的平安夜家庭盛宴）。

mission.en: Thank him warmly and accept the invitation
mission.zh: 热情致谢并欣然答应赴约

mission.en: Ask about traditional Polish Christmas Eve food
mission.zh: 询问波兰平安夜的传统美食与习俗

mission.en: Explain how you celebrate holidays back home
mission.zh: 介绍自己家乡是如何庆祝传统重大节日的

complication.en: He asks you to bring a dish; ask what would fit the tradition.
complication.zh: 他建议你带一道菜过去，你需要问清楚什么食物符合当地传统。

opener.en: Hello! What are you doing for Christmas Eve?
opener.zh: 你好呀！平安夜那天有什么安排吗？

first_question.en: Would you like to come over to our place for dinner?
first_question.zh: 你愿意来我们家一起吃顿便饭过节吗？

closer.en: We'll expect you then! Merry Christmas!
closer.zh: 那到时候恭候你啦！圣诞快乐！

phrases.en: Thank you so much for the invitation!
phrases.zh: “非常感谢您的盛情邀请！”（用于礼貌应邀致谢）

phrases.en: I'd love to come! What time should I arrive?
phrases.zh: “我很乐意去！我大概几点到合适？”（用于欣然赴约并确认时间）

phrases.en: What do people traditionally eat on Christmas Eve?
phrases.zh: “波兰人在平安夜通常都吃什么特色菜？”（用于探讨当地文化习俗）

phrases.en: Back home in China, we celebrate with dumplings.
phrases.zh: “在我们中国老家，过节时大家一般会包饺子吃。”（用于分享中国传统食俗）

phrases.en: Merry Christmas to you and your family!
phrases.zh: “祝您和家人圣诞快乐！”（用于节日祝福）

grammar_focus.en: Accepting invitations politely: "I'd love to..." and "Thank you for..."
grammar_focus.zh: 应邀与致谢的礼貌表达：动词短语“I'd love to + 动词原形”与介词短语“Thank you for + 名词”。

can_do.en: I can compare two cities and give reasons for my opinions.
can_do.zh: 我能对比两座城市并陈述自己的理由与观点。

scene.en: Lunch break in Kraków; your team lead Ania, who is originally from Warsaw, says it is much better than Kraków.
scene.zh: 在克拉科夫的公司午休吃饭时，来自华沙的主管阿尼娅（Ania）坚称华沙比克拉科夫好得多。

mission.en: Compare the two cities on two different points
mission.zh: 从两个不同的方面对比这两座城市

mission.en: Give your opinion with clear reasons
mission.zh: 给出自己的明确看法并陈述理由

mission.en: Find something both of you can agree on
mission.zh: 找到双方都能认可的共同点

complication.en: She asks where you would like to live in ten years.
complication.zh: 她询问你十年之后更想在哪个城市定居。

opener.en: Come on, admit it—Warsaw is way better than Kraków!
opener.zh: 得了吧，承认吧——华沙可比克拉科夫好多了！

first_question.en: Go on, what makes Kraków any better?
first_question.zh: 你说说看，克拉科夫到底哪儿好了？

closer.en: All right, let's call it a draw! Back to work.
closer.zh: 行吧，算打个平手！该回去干活了。

phrases.en: Kraków is smaller, but it's much prettier.
phrases.zh: “克拉科夫是小一点，但风景漂亮得多。”（用于多角度对比城市优缺点）

phrases.en: There are more job opportunities in Warsaw.
phrases.zh: “华沙的工作机会确实更多。”（用于客观陈述大城市的优势）

phrases.en: I agree with you on that, but...
phrases.zh: “那一点我赞同你，不过……”（用于部分赞同后表达转折）

phrases.en: In my opinion, life here is more relaxed.
phrases.zh: “依我看，这里的生活节奏更舒适安逸。”（用于表达生活感受）

phrases.en: In ten years, I'd like to live near the mountains.
phrases.zh: “十年后，我更想住在离山近一点的地方。”（用于表达对未来定居地的设想）

grammar_focus.en: Comparatives: short adjectives with "-er" (smaller, prettier) and "more + noun" (more jobs)
grammar_focus.zh: 比较级句型：单音节/双音节形容词词尾加 -er（如 smaller, prettier）及“more + 名词”表达数量更多。

can_do.en: I can talk about future plans and imagine hypothetical situations.
can_do.zh: 我能谈论未来的计划并设想假设性的情境。

scene.en: A late-night chat over tea with your friend Kasia about plans, dreams, and bucket lists.
scene.zh: 深夜和好友卡夏（Kasia）喝茶闲聊，畅谈未来的规划、梦想与愿望清单。

mission.en: Share what you plan to do next year
mission.zh: 分享自己明年的具体打算

mission.en: Describe what you would do with more time or money
mission.zh: 描绘如果有更多时间或财富想做什么

mission.en: Ask her about her own future dreams
mission.zh: 反问她的梦想与规划

complication.en: She asks why you decided to learn Polish.
complication.zh: 她好奇地问你当初为什么会选择学波兰语。

opener.en: Hey, do you have any big plans for next year?
opener.zh: 哎，你想过明年有什么大计划吗？

first_question.en: What will you be working on?

closer.en: It's getting late—time for bed. Good night!

phrases.en: Next year, I'm planning to travel around Europe.
phrases.zh: “明年我打算周游欧洲各国。”（用于分享明年的明确打算）

phrases.en: If I had more time, I would travel more.
phrases.zh: “如果我有更多时间，我会多去各地走走。”（用于表达假设条件下的愿望）

phrases.en: I'm learning Polish because I live here.
phrases.zh: “我学波兰语是因为我生活在这里。”（用于解释学习语言的缘由）

phrases.en: It has always been a dream of mine.
phrases.zh: “这一直是我长久以来的一个梦想。”（用于抒发个人长远志向）

phrases.en: What would you do in my shoes?
phrases.zh: “要是换成你，你会怎么做？”（用于反问对方在假定情境下的想法）

grammar_focus.en: Second conditional for dreams and wishes: "If I had..., I would..."
grammar_focus.zh: 第二类条件句（If I had..., I would...），用于表达与现在事实相反的假想或美好愿望。
